# MousePosition

[API index](../index.md)

```typescript
const MousePosition: Vector2;
```

Current world cursor in grid units, using the same source as entity cursor geometry.
Returns the zero vector when no game area is available.

**@keywords**

cursor, mouse, targeting, grid, position
